title: Canonical residue tensor counit and defining equations
statement: Use [new-integral-residue-tensor-presentation]. Name its explicit ordinary coefficient object and canonical derived tensor counit, prove the left-derived universal property, and identify the original tensor presentation with the generic presentation fixed by this counit. The data are the existing balanced tensor construction, with no choices from mere existence.

proof.text: Name the explicit restricted regular coefficient and the canonical balanced tensor counit. Reuse its proved left-derived universal property. Prove the generic constructor defining equation by reflexivity, then specialize it to the original concrete tensor presentation.

proof_origin.note: A2 second reading: proved defining API for the existing canonical tensor presentation. A separate module avoids a remote compiler timeout without changing the original presentation module.
